observations: The sampled sequence covers the collage, product introduction, terminal demonstration, retrospective, visitor milestone, gallery, community statement, three audience roles, thank-you and branded ending.
The black background, white headings, thin pink-to-violet accent typography and small outlined capsules broadly match.
The settled product heading and supporting copy retain the 500+ quantity and Claude Code, Cursor and Codex badges.
The setup scene preserves left-side copy, a right-side terminal, progressive command text, green success text and overlapping result cards.
The settled milestone reads 1,000,000 with visitors in one month., a rising gradient graph and celebratory particles.
The completed community statement, developer/designer/founder labels, thank you., motionsites wordmark, 1M and counting. tagline and domain CTA are represented.
The ending includes staged text, confetti and a fade toward black.
remaining_differences: The full-resolution opening pair shows a substantially different collage crop and card arrangement. ORIGINAL centers the robot-headed person and blue-tree page, with Mars and a crowned winged figure at left; GPT centers Anchor AI and Agent Wave, with the robot card cropped at the top. The tilted, edge-filling grid mechanism is retained.

Website subjects are much simpler in GPT: the luminous tree becomes a sparse radial fan, the pastel creature becomes a flat face, and foliage, characters and metallic forms use broad geometric shapes. ORIGINAL contains textured imagery, dimensional subjects and denser interface detail. These differences recur in the gallery and floating cards.
ORIGINAL has already cleared the collage to black beneath the emerging THE DESIGN heading. GPT retains the collage as a visibly darkened background behind its heading.

ORIGINAL has entered the setup scene, showing an emerging One and a mostly empty terminal. GPT still displays the complete product-introduction heading and bottom preview row. At 7–9 seconds its terminal typing also trails the reference: ORIGINAL has the landing-page request underway at 9 seconds while GPT is showing the success response.

ORIGINAL already shows overlapping result previews in front of the terminal, while GPT has no preview cards at this timestamp. At 11 seconds GPT's cards are smaller and form a shallower fan than ORIGINAL's larger, more strongly overlapping cards.
ORIGINAL shows the sparse 8 MONTHS AGO retrospective reveal. GPT still shows the terminal, left-side setup copy and result cards.

The completed brand name is correct, but the mark and wordmark shapes differ visibly. ORIGINAL has a rounded, ribbon-like M with peach, pink and violet bends and a rounded lowercase wordmark; GPT uses a narrower pink-purple mark and broader, more conventional bold lettering. The same construction difference appears in the final lockup.
ORIGINAL shows Today, alone on black. GPT still holds the large retrospective logo and we launched text, omitting this sampled standalone-word state.

The dark automotive background has different subject geometry: ORIGINAL shows a dimensional silver car in three-quarter view with its hood open; GPT shows a flat side-profile car illustration inside a conspicuous page rectangle.

The dense samples expose a rapid background montage missing from GPT. ORIGINAL changes through a woman, blue tree, pastel creature, crystalline imagery, a pale typography page, foliage, architecture, car typography and Mars imagery between 17.2333 and 17.8667 seconds. GPT retains the same side-profile car throughout those samples, then changes to a green page by 17.9667 seconds.

ORIGINAL has isolated the visitor counter and label on black. GPT overlaps the counter with the still-visible Today, we hit statement and green website background, making competing text layers occupy the same area.

The full-resolution pair shows mismatched counter mechanics and graph progress. GPT exposes large, sharply cut portions of adjacent digits above and below the number baseline; ORIGINAL's changing digits are more softly blurred. ORIGINAL's graph reaches roughly two-thirds across its frame with a clear rising area, while GPT's short, nearly flat segment reaches only about one-quarter across.

GPT's leading digit is already a bright 1 while ORIGINAL still displays a dark leading 0. The graph also remains substantially shorter and lower in GPT at 21–22 seconds. Both reach the settled million display by the 23-second sample.

ORIGINAL's milestone confetti is distributed broadly around the number and graph. GPT's visible burst is concentrated in a small cluster near the capsule, then becomes more broadly distributed at 24 seconds.

ORIGINAL has switched to a centered gallery browser. GPT still holds the million-visitor composition. At 27–29 seconds the browser layout is broadly similar, but GPT repeats simplified thumbnail states where ORIGINAL shows changing subject states and richer imagery.

ORIGINAL has begun the left-copy/right-gallery composition with One million people emerging. GPT still shows the isolated centered browser. At 31–34 seconds GPT's enlarged gallery extends farther left behind the statement and uses larger-looking card contents, changing the balance between the foreground copy and the cropped panel.

ORIGINAL has entered To every developer. with surrounding cards, while GPT still holds the community statement and gallery. The role transitions also miss important sampled states: at 37 and 39 seconds ORIGINAL shows blurred designer. and founder. respectively, while GPT shows only To every with the large role and surrounding cards absent.

The founder cards preserve approximate positions but lose observed internal subject changes. ORIGINAL's upper-left automotive card shows an engine assembly at 40 seconds and an open-hood car at 41 seconds; GPT shows its simplified side-profile car at both timestamps. The upper-right and lower-right cards also use substantially flatter imagery.

ORIGINAL has cleared the audience cards and displays Building with us — on black. GPT still shows founder. and all three cards. At 43 seconds GPT reveals the full thank you. phrase as a blurred unit, whereas ORIGINAL has a legible thank with the following portion still emerging.

ORIGINAL shows only the small gradient brand mark beginning the ending. GPT still holds the complete thank-you composition. At 48 seconds both show the wordmark lockup, but ORIGINAL already has substantial confetti overhead while GPT's frame is nearly particle-free.

The final tagline is considerably wider in GPT, with a larger 1M and larger thin and counting. text relative to the logo. ORIGINAL's tagline forms a more compact centered line. This proportion difference remains visible in the full-resolution 54.15-second pair.

Both final cards are fading, but GPT's logo, tagline and CTA are noticeably darker than ORIGINAL at the same requested timestamp. The confetti distributions also differ, with GPT retaining more visible pieces toward the upper area.

adapted_review_history.revision_feedback: Preserve the established sequence, correct copy, black-and-gradient styling, setup layout and settled milestone. First correct scene boundaries against the supplied timestamp anchors; a single global offset will not fix the differing delays. Replace the prolonged car background with the evidenced rapid montage, clear outgoing layers before the counter, synchronize graph extent with the sampled counter states, and retain partially revealed role words and cards during audience transitions. Then enrich independently authored website subjects, refine collage cropping and card overlap, and reduce the final tagline's scale.
adapted_review_history.prompt_improvement_markdown:
Revise the existing composition while preserving its correct text, scene order and settled layouts.

- Match these sampled states explicitly: setup begins by 6s; retrospective begins by 12s; standalone `Today,` appears at 16s; counter is isolated on black at 19s; gallery appears at 26s; community copy begins at 30s; developer acknowledgment appears at 35s; `Building with us —` replaces the cards at 42s; the isolated final mark appears at 47s.
- Reconstruct the background changes evidenced between 17.2333s and 17.9667s using newly authored or authorized imagery. Keep `Today, we hit` above the darkened backgrounds, then remove both before the counter-only state.
- Refine the rolling digits with softer transitional glyphs and controlled clipping. Keep the leading zero through the evidenced pre-million states. Match the graph's visible length and height at 20–22s, including its faint area fill and bright endpoint.
- Show result cards by 10s, with the larger overlapping fan evident at 11s. Preserve partially visible role replacements and surrounding cards at 37s and 39s instead of leaving only `To every`.
- Increase the dimensional detail and interface density of independently authored website previews. Include the automotive engine/open-hood states, luminous tree, textured foliage, dimensional creature, fashion and architecture subjects. Match the opening crop and gallery balance without embedding supplied frames.
- Refine the rounded ribbon mark and wordmark proportions using independently authored geometry. Make the final tagline more compact, introduce final confetti by 48s, and retain slightly more visibility at 54.15s.
